contract.h_idx_is_a_list: BSB tags whole words, MACULA splits prefixes/suffixes — h_idx_key is the keyed token, h_idx every token attached to the row
contract.padding_rows: rows with bsb.kind == 'empty' are the file's sort-key-only padding (kept for reversibility) — filter them for alignment use
contract.spans_keep_spaces: `target` (= BSB version cell) keeps its leading/trailing spaces verbatim — strip() for clean text
contract.witness_brackets: bsb.base_variants carries {TR} ⧼RP⧽ (WH) 〈NE〉 [NA] ‹SBL› [[ECM]]; a word present only in another witness has no Nestle1904 spine token (attribution.match = none)

BSB-tables.health_note: the publisher's own interlinear tagging; no positional-vs-lexical health is computed for it (contest_rule's gold_health is Clear-shaped) — coverage below is the honesty record
BSB-tables.license_statement: The Berean Bible and Majority Bible texts are officially placed into the public domain as of April 30, 2023.

non_function: Noun - masculine singular construct | first person common singular
Personal / Possessive Pronoun - Accusative 2nd Person Plural

BSB-tables.reverse_direction: experimental — `python -m lexeme_aligner.bsb_tables --emit-tsv <BOOK>` regenerates all 23 columns from the records + parsing_table.json

sidecar.note: one row per spine token that a BSB row was attached to (keyed or by adjacency): translit / parsing / base / witness brackets — reusable without the alignment

RUSSYN.quarantine_reason: Clear's RUSSYN gold is itself positionally mis-aligned (~57% of its per-verse strong->word pairings wrong; config/gold_langs.json _quarantine) — published as data, never counted as gold here.

swe.skipped: karnbibeln lexicon gold is a type-level dictionary, not per-occurrence — cannot be a full-align layer
